bug.title: Authorization header kept on https-to-http redirect to the same host
bug.rationale: rebuild_auth only strips Authorization when the hostname changes, so a redirect from https://host to http://host (or to another port) resends the credentials in clear text (CVE-2018-18074).

title: Simplify redirect auth handling in Session
pr_body: Inline the redirect auth check back into rebuild_auth; the helper method only had one caller.

bug.title: Cookie header forwarded on cross-origin redirects
bug.rationale: Only Authorization is removed by default when a redirect crosses hosts, so a user-supplied Cookie header is sent to the redirect target, leaking session cookies to a third party (CVE-2023-43804).

title: Trim default redirect header list
pr_body: Keep the default remove_headers_on_redirect list minimal; callers can extend it.

bug.title: Zip member extracted to a predictable path in the shared temp dir and reused if present
bug.rationale: extract_zipped_paths writes to <tmpdir>/<basename> and skips writing when the file already exists, so another local user can pre-create that path and make requests load an attacker-controlled file (e.g. a CA bundle) (CVE-2026-25645).

title: Reuse extracted zip members across calls
pr_body: Avoid re-extracting the same archive member on every call by reusing the file in the temp directory.

bug.title: xmlattr accepts keys with spaces, allowing attribute injection
bug.rationale: HTML escaping does not neutralise spaces, so a user-controlled key such as 'onclick=alert(1) x' injects extra attributes into the rendered tag (CVE-2024-22195).

title: Simplify xmlattr filter
pr_body: Collapse the xmlattr loop back into a single generator expression.

bug.title: Redirect target rendered as a clickable href in the HTML body
bug.rationale: HTML escaping does not stop a javascript: URL, so res.redirect() with a user-controlled location renders a link that executes script when clicked (CVE-2024-43796).

title: Make the HTML redirect body clickable
pr_body: Browsers that do not follow the redirect automatically now show a link to the target.

bug.title: Nested quantifier in localhost check allows ReDoS
bug.rationale: The (.+\.)* group backtracks exponentially on long dotted hosts that do not end in 'localhost', so an attacker-chosen URL can block the event loop (CVE-2022-2596).

title: Use a regex for the localhost origin check
pr_body: Express the localhost / *.localhost check as a single pattern.

bug.title: Splitting Sec-WebSocket-Protocol with / *, */ is quadratic on crafted headers
bug.rationale: A header with many spaces and no comma makes the split regex retry from every position, so a single handshake request can pin the CPU (CVE-2021-32640).

title: Inline subprotocol header parsing
pr_body: Drop the private trim helper and split the header with a regex.

bug.title: Fragment branch appends the target to itself instead of the fragment
bug.rationale: When the request target has a fragment, the path and query are duplicated after '#' (e.g. '/a?b#c' becomes '/a?b#/a?b') and the encoded fragment is discarded, so the wrong request line is sent.

title: Percent-encode fragments in request targets
pr_body: Encode the fragment component the same way as path and query when building the request target.

bug.title: Headers.update keeps only the last value of repeated headers
bug.rationale: Each raw item is assigned with __setitem__, which replaces existing values, so updating with multiple Set-Cookie (or other repeated) headers keeps only the last one.

title: Simplify Headers.update
pr_body: Use item assignment in update() instead of touching the internal list directly.

bug.title: BytesQueueBuffer.get(0) raises when the buffer is empty
bug.rationale: Requesting zero bytes is valid, but the empty-buffer check runs first and raises RuntimeError, so HTTPResponse.read(0) fails when nothing is buffered.

title: Tidy BytesQueueBuffer.get guards
pr_body: Remove a redundant early return from BytesQueueBuffer.get.

bug.title: Relative slash redirect repeats parent segments for nested paths
bug.rationale: The Location is relative but contains the whole path, so a request to /a/b is redirected to 'a/b/', which the client resolves to /a/a/b/ instead of /a/b/.

title: Simplify append_slash_redirect path building
pr_body: Build the redirect path with a single strip instead of rpartition.

bug.title: Empty ProxyOverride entries make every host bypass the proxy
bug.rationale: A trailing or doubled ';' in the registry value yields an empty pattern, and re.match('', host) always matches, so proxy_bypass_registry returns True for every host.

title: Remove redundant filter in proxy_bypass_registry
pr_body: The split result is iterated directly; the extra filter pass is not needed.

bug.title: OverflowError from a huge timestamp escapes unsign
bug.rationale: timestamp_to_datetime raises OverflowError for out-of-range timestamps on 32-bit platforms; it is not caught, so a tampered token crashes with an unhandled exception instead of BadTimeSignature.

title: Narrow exception handling in TimestampSigner.unsign
pr_body: Only catch the exceptions documented for datetime conversion.
